'''Team Thumper''' was a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] military unit during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. During the [[Mission to Sunfall Peak]], it infiltrated an [[Imperial communications hub]] to place explosives. [[Team Bantha]] then rendezvoused, with [[Ryenne]] hacking the door to allow them to escape.<ref name="Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook" />
